name: The majority voted against an [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debates/?id=2023-08-01.93.2) introduced by Goldstein MP [Zoe Daniel](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/goldstein/zoe_daniel). The amendment would have amended a previous amendment introduced by Curtin MP [Kate Chaney](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/curtin/kate_chaney) (Independent), which was to add the words below to the usual second reading motion, which is "*that the bill be read a second time*" (parliamentary jargon for agreeing with the main idea of the bill). ### Ms Chaney's amendment > *That all words after "That" be omitted with a view to substituting the following words:* > > *"The House declines to give the bill a second reading until such time as the report on the Robodebt Royal Commission is handed down".* ### Ms Daniel's amendment > *That all words after "time" be omitted with a view to substituting the following words:* > > *"as the government responds to the recommendations of the Robodebt Royal Commission, the results of the Secretaries Board Integrity Taskforce review are made public and the recommendations of the Thodey Review on appointments and termination of Secretaries are acted upon".*
